nodes.description: ERC20Basic token contract held by the lockup (set in constructor to 0x814F67fA286f7572B041D041b1D99b432c9155Ee)
Address that receives released tokens (set to 0x4BDE3B2F0F43B17407F2f91E1f18F9e130Cd804A)
Timestamp after which the full balance is unlocked; set to now + year in constructor
Amount currently withdrawable; half of balance initially, full balance after releaseTime, decremented on each release
Boolean guard ensuring the 50% unlock is only computed once
Constant 365 days used to compute releaseTime in the constructor
Constructor initializing token, beneficiary and releaseTime = now + year
Public function that computes the unlocked amount and transfers tokens to the beneficiary
View helper returning the token balance held by this contract
View helper returning the current block timestamp
Block timestamp (now) used for releaseTime computation and for the release window check
External call into the token contract via SafeERC20.safeTransfer, executed after state updates
SafeMath subtraction decreasing the unlocked balance; arithmetic operation on state
SafeMath division of the contract token balance by 2 to compute the initial unlock
Caller-supplied amount to release, required to be <= unlocked
Cached result of token.balanceOf(address(this)) used to derive unlocked and to gate the transfer

edges.reason: block.timestamp is compared against releaseTime to decide whether the full balance becomes unlocked
currentTime() returns the raw block timestamp, exposing block time dependence
constructor computes releaseTime = now + year from the block timestamp
year constant is used to compute releaseTime in the constructor
constructor assigns the held token contract
constructor assigns the beneficiary address
constructor assigns releaseTime
release writes the unlocked state variable
release sets withdrawalsInitiated to true on first call
release reads the contract token balance into the local variable balance
balance is divided by two to derive the initial unlocked amount
balance is assigned to unlocked once releaseTime has passed
unlocked is decremented through SafeMath sub on each release
caller-supplied _amount is subtracted from the unlocked balance
caller-supplied _amount is forwarded to the external token transfer
the token contract stored in state is the target of the external transfer call
beneficiary address is the recipient of the external token transfer
release invokes an external call (token.safeTransfer) at the end of its execution
external token transfer can call back into release before the call returns, re-reading the mutated unlocked state
releaseTime gates whether the whole balance becomes unlocked in release
withdrawalsInitiated conditionally guards the one-time 50% unlock logic
balanceOf() queries the held token contract for this contract's balance

normalization_plan.reason: The caller-supplied _amount parameter is only a transient value flowing into the external token transfer; it should be merged into the unsafe_operation node representing that call.
The local cache of token.balanceOf(address(this)) is scoped to the release function and only serves to compute unlocked and gate the transfer, so it collapses into the release function node.
